data_dir.description: Directory for managed database files. Only for `managed`; when omitted Knowell uses its default data directory.

url.description: Reference to the connection URL, e.g. `env:KNOWELL_DATABASE_URL`. Required for `external`, not allowed for `managed`.

oneOf.description: Knowell starts and manages its own PostgreSQL instance.
Knowell connects to a PostgreSQL server you operate; requires `url`.

token.description: Reference to the access token, e.g. `env:KNOWELL_HUB_TOKEN`.

api_key.description: Reference to the API key, e.g. `env:GEMINI_API_KEY`. Required for `gemini` and `voyage`, optional for `openai-compatible`, not allowed for `ollama`.

base_url.description: Endpoint base URL (`http://` or `https://`). Required for `openai-compatible`; optional for `gemini` and `voyage`; for `ollama` it defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:11434` when omitted.

model.description: Default embedding model for workspaces that do not name one.

oneOf.description: Any server speaking the OpenAI embeddings API; requires `base_url`.

SecretRef.description: Reference to a secret, never the secret itself: 'env:<VARIABLE>' or 'file:<path>'.

listen.description: Address to listen on, as `ip:port`. Defaults to `127.0.0.1:7420`. Every role except `hub` must use a loopback address so the local panel is never exposed to the network.

role.description: Role of this process. Defaults to `standalone`.

ServerRole.description: Role of this process in a deployment.

oneOf.description: One machine runs everything: panel, indexer and agent endpoint.
Central server shared by a team. The only role that may listen on a non-loopback address.
Indexing worker that serves a hub.
Developer machine that talks to a hub; requires the `[hub]` table.

enabled.description: Whether anonymous usage telemetry may be sent. Defaults to `false`; Knowell never sends telemetry without this opt-in.

description:
Engine configuration, normally stored at `~/.knowell/config.toml`.

Holds machine-level settings only. Which projects exist and how they are indexed lives in the workspace file (`knowell.toml`). Secrets are never written here: use references such as `env:GEMINI_API_KEY`.

database.description: Where Knowell stores its index and memory.

hub.description: Connection to the hub. Required when `server.role = "edge"`, and only allowed then.

providers.description: Embedding providers, keyed by a name that workspaces refer to.

server.description: Network role and listen address of this process.

title: EngineConfig
